$schema-note: Adapter inputs for one corpus build. `corpus build --inputs <path>` reads this file. Every `inputPath` is relative to $MAILWOMAN_DATA_ROOT, resolved at launch.
$overlay-note: This build rebuilds wof-admin for the v0.8.5-overlay over v0.8.4-overlay (#2854). The canonical and colloquial names of each record render every ordered subset of their locality, county, region and country ancestors, each level in its canonical form and in one rotating alternate: the country's codex surface forms, the libaddressinput region code, and colloquial names. Romanized chains in largest-first countries are written smallest first. The input holds every Who's On First admin repository, 260 of them with 6,160,625 records, where v0.8.4 read 12 countries. wof-postalcode is rebuilt separately (v0.8.5-wof-postalcode) so the two adapters' record indexes are not resident together.
